Running Python code interactively: import struct
import binascii
import zlib

with open('/workspace/test_rar5.rar', 'rb') as f:
    data = f.read()

# RAR5 signature: 52 61 72 21 1a 07 01 00
sig = data[:8]
print(f"Signature: {binascii.hexlify(sig).decode()}")

# After signature, headers follow. Each header:
# - CRC32 (4 bytes LE)
# - Header size (vint)
# - Header type (vint)
# ...

def read_vint(data, offset):
    """Read a variable-length integer (RAR5 vint format)"""
    val = 0
    shift = 0
    consumed = 0
    while True:
        b = data[offset + consumed]
        consumed += 1
        val |= (b & 0x7f) << shift
        shift += 7
        if (b & 0x80) == 0:
            break
    return val, consumed

pos = 8  # skip signature
header_num = 0
while pos < len(data) and header_num < 5:
    header_num += 1
    print(f"\n--- Header #{header_num} at offset {pos} ---")
    hdr_crc = struct.unpack_from('<I', data, pos)[0]
    pos += 4
    print(f"  CRC32: {hdr_crc:#010x}")
    
    raw_hdr_size, size_len = read_vint(data, pos)
    hdr_size = raw_hdr_size + size_len
    print(f"  Raw header size: {raw_hdr_size}, size_len: {size_len}, total hdr_size: {hdr_size}")
    
    hdr_start = pos
    pos += size_len
    
    header_id, id_len = read_vint(data, pos)
    pos += id_len
    print(f"  Header type: {header_id}")
    
    header_flags, flags_len = read_vint(data, pos)
    pos += flags_len
    print(f"  Header flags: {header_flags:#06x}")
    
    extra_data_size = 0
    data_size = 0
    if header_flags & 0x0001:  # HFL_EXTRA_DATA
        extra_data_size, ed_len = read_vint(data, pos)
        pos += ed_len
        print(f"  Extra data size: {extra_data_size}")
    if header_flags & 0x0002:  # HFL_DATA
        data_size, ds_len = read_vint(data, pos)
        pos += ds_len
        print(f"  Data size: {data_size}")
    
    if header_id == 1:  # HEAD_MAIN
        archive_flags, af_len = read_vint(data, pos)
        pos += af_len
        print(f"  Archive flags: {archive_flags:#06x} (solid={bool(archive_flags & 0x0004)})")
    elif header_id == 2:  # HEAD_FILE
        file_flags, ff_len = read_vint(data, pos)
        pos += ff_len
        print(f"  File flags: {file_flags:#06x}")
        
        unpacked_size, us_len = read_vint(data, pos)
        pos += us_len
        print(f"  Unpacked size: {unpacked_size}")
        
        file_attr, fa_len = read_vint(data, pos)
        pos += fa_len
        print(f"  File attr: {file_attr:#06x}")
        
        if file_flags & 0x0002:  # UTIME
            mtime = struct.unpack_from('<I', data, pos)[0]
            pos += 4
            print(f"  Mtime: {mtime}")
        
        if file_flags & 0x0004:  # CRC32
            crc = struct.unpack_from('<I', data, pos)[0]
            pos += 4
            print(f"  CRC32: {crc:#010x}")
        
        compression_info, ci_len = read_vint(data, pos)
        pos += ci_len
        c_method = (compression_info >> 7) & 0x7
        c_version = compression_info & 0x3f
        window_shift = (compression_info >> 10) & 15
        window_size = 0x20000 << window_shift
        is_solid = bool(compression_info & 0x0040)
        print(f"  Compression info: {compression_info:#06x}")
        print(f"    method={c_method}, version={c_version}, window_shift={window_shift}, window_size={window_size:#x}, solid={is_solid}")
    
    # Reset pos to end of header
    pos = hdr_start + hdr_size
    if data_size > 0:
        print(f"  [Data follows: {data_size} bytes]")
        pos += data_size
